segments.sn46.77-88:1.1: 258-269. “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā;
segments.sn46.77-88:1.2: evameva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro.
segments.sn46.77-88:1.3: Kathañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro?
segments.sn46.77-88:1.4: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti … pe … upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ … pe … evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro”ti.(Yāva esanā pāḷi vitthāretabbā).
segments.sn46.77-88:2.1: Cha pācīnato ninnā, cha ninnā ca samuddato;
segments.sn46.77-88:2.3: Dvete cha dvādasa honti, vaggo tena pavuccatīti.
